When Ms [name redacted] friend rang the 111 service on her behalf, the possibility of conveying her to hospital by means other than an ambulance was discussed with her and she declined. However, it was not discussed with her friend who made the call. He would have been much better placed to organise this and, if he had, it would probably have resulted in life saving hospital treatment. The potentially very grave consequences of a vomiting illness in a person with diabetes were not explained to him.
